claim: Audited union of bounded generated recipes and preserved compatible baseline descriptions; complete content coverage is unresolved.

rows.scope: Story exteriors, interiors, dungeon rooms, islands and stage transitions
rows.mapping: Only explicit resource/state rows map to generated descriptions. Archive references never cover all members or a loaded stage.
rows.unresolved: Every unlisted archive and every unexercised member/controller of a referenced archive; complete scene construction, fog/lighting and story state changes.
rows.risk: High: unexercised stages or actor-controlled material state can introduce first-use pipelines.
rows.resolution: Add validated asset/controller recipes and regenerate, or record explicit owner acceptance of this remaining generation gap at final validation.

rows.scope: Optional caves, minigames, collectibles, sidequests and non-story interiors
rows.mapping: Listed stock optional-cave resources have only their isolated stock draw evidence; identical complete descriptions can share configuration mappings.
rows.unresolved: Unlisted optional locations, minigame controllers, special actors, optional reward and interaction states.
rows.risk: High: optional rendering setups are not established by story-resource sharing.
rows.resolution: Add recipes with source/state attribution or record explicit owner acceptance; obtaining progression saves is not a default prerequisite.

rows.scope: Ordinary actors, NPCs, enemies, bosses and phase/state transitions
rows.mapping: Only the fixed actor/effect draws and explicit stock model rows are exercised; retained state mappings identify each complete configuration.
rows.unresolved: Other actors and boss phases, behavior/AI, collision/hit prerequisites, attachments, animation and environment-lighting/controller equivalence.
rows.risk: High: isolated models and shared effects do not certify complete actors or boss encounters.
rows.resolution: Add bounded actor/state recipes, retain known runtime supplementation without invented path attribution, or record explicit owner acceptance.

rows.scope: Equipment models, projectiles, attacks, item effects and first/repeated actions
rows.mapping: Finite arrow and bomb/effect scripts retain their actual draw/state descriptions and source-specific mappings.
rows.unresolved: Other equipment controllers, hit/collision and trail effects, player attachment/animation, action/environment combinations and unsupported rows.
rows.risk: High: item ownership or model loading does not execute every action rendering state.
rows.resolution: Extend runnable action recipes or record explicit owner acceptance; selected physical equipment observations use only existing ordinary saves.

rows.scope: Smoke, explosions, debris, elemental effects, finite lifetimes and selected simultaneous emitters
rows.mapping: Real common-bank emitter update/draw lifetimes and selected overlaps map full descriptions to variations and ticks; equal descriptions justify only those shared configurations.
rows.unresolved: Other particle banks/IDs, model particles, stage wind/lighting, framebuffer/projection effects, actor collision, cameras and unselected overlaps.
rows.risk: High: the common bank and selected overlaps do not enumerate complete effect/controller behavior.
rows.resolution: Add validated bank/controller/overlap scripts or record explicit owner acceptance. Observed missing-pipeline waits always require correction.

rows.scope: Ocean, water, fog, projected shadows, alpha volumes, weather, sky and reflections
rows.mapping: Actual fixed ocean/simple-shadow/alpha packet draws and their bounded overlap retain state and layout mappings. Numeric uniform changes only share configurations when full bytes agree.
rows.unresolved: Waves/storm controllers, real shadow capture/receivers, rectangular textures, mirrors/reflections, precipitation/clouds, underwater/sky and dungeon water, other alpha packets and combinations.
rows.risk: High: supplied planes/flat grid and selected GX ordering do not establish complete gameplay equivalence.
rows.resolution: Extend scene/capture recipes or record explicit owner acceptance; selected shoreline regression does not close other environment gaps.

rows.scope: File selection, inventory and other native UI layouts, text and controllers
rows.mapping: J2DPicture plain/tinted/faded/repeated states and the explicitly justified shared setup have generated evidence only for the selected native texture and setup.
rows.unresolved: Other textures, fonts/text, complete layouts, menu controllers and framebuffer/cloth effects.
rows.risk: High: one shared color setup cannot certify all native menus.
rows.resolution: Add menu/layout/controller exercises or record explicit owner acceptance; retain first/repeat physical menu observations separately.

rows.scope: Transition overlays, cinematic rendering, one-time/title/ending scenes
rows.mapping: Actual transition fade overlay states and listed stock title resources are the bounded evidence; a fade is not cinematic playback.
rows.unresolved: Cinematic camera/story controllers, blur/monochrome/depth/spot framebuffer effects and inaccessible one-time scenes.
rows.resolution: Add targeted maintainer recipes or record explicit owner acceptance; full story replay is not required by default.

rows.scope: Hero/casual clothes, alternate playthrough, language/dialogue and mode-specific visibility
rows.mapping: The hero/casual/hero texture cycle and explicit stock-resource sharing establish only the listed configurations, not an alternate playthrough.
rows.unresolved: Hat/buckle visibility, face/body ordering, attachments, animation, dialogue, mode controllers and alternate-only events.
rows.risk: High: texture substitution alone does not reproduce all alternate-mode draw state.
rows.resolution: Add mode/visibility recipes or record explicit owner acceptance. Do not edit owner save flags or require a completion save.

rows.scope: Camera/world/fog/state variations, scene/offscreen targets, destination-alpha variants and effect ordering
rows.mapping: The complete host/PS4 representation witness, ordinary recorder comparisons and exact selected draw-state identities support description compatibility. Host BGRA and PS4 RGBA driver objects remain distinct.
rows.unresolved: Actual PS4 preparation of every required layout, offscreen capture use, inherited GX state outside selected ordering and all unselected reachable combinations.
rows.risk: High: ABI equality and seed counts cannot certify target driver success or unexecuted runtime paths.
rows.resolution: Retain required target-layout/preparation evidence and bounded first/repeat observations; extend missing recipes or record eligible owner acceptance. Failed creation or observed missing waits cannot be waived.
